title: Company OKR Orchestra and Execution Telemetry
creator: Hannah Grant
description:
Problem: As Redwood scales, cross-functional initiatives frequently diverge from company OKRs mid-quarter because owners lack a single, operational mapping and live telemetry to show execution health. This causes duplicated effort, missed SLAs for Dedicated customers, and reactive re-prioritization.

Goal: Build an operational "OKR Orchestra": a documented mapping (OKR -> initiative -> owner -> milestones) plus an execution telemetry surface (Redwood Console dashboard and a light-weight playbook) that provides near-real-time health signals (milestone completion, rollout success rates, regression alerts tied to evals) for leadership and owners.

Scope: company-level OKRs and 8 top cross-functional initiatives (runtime performance, Dedicated autoscale, Private upgrade path, Console rollouts, Optimize cost toolkit, Reliability SLOs, Model catalog onboarding, Security & Compliance enhancements). Deliverables: 1) initiative contracts template; 2) canonical OKR->initiative registry (CSV/Confluence); 3) Console dashboard with 6 telemetry tiles; 4) playbook for weekly OKR syncs and escalation.

Out-of-scope: team-level sprint tracking and individual PR status. This ticket focuses on cross-team alignment artifacts and the telemetry surface required for executive and initiative-owner decisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical OKR->initiative registry published in Confluence with owners and milestone dates
Initiative contract template approved by PM, Eng, and Design leads (signed in doc)
Redwood Console dashboard live with tiles: milestone completion %, rollout failure rate, avg token latency change, cost-per-token trend, canary pass rate, and evaluation regression count
Weekly playbook doc published and a recurring 30m OKR sync calendar invite created
Three initiative owners onboarded and verified they can interpret telemetry and trigger escalation flows

decisions: Telemetry surface will be built on top of existing Console metrics; no new ingestion pipeline required for first phase
Initiative contract will require PM/Eng/Design sign-off before being listed as 'owned' in the registry
Use 'at-risk' threshold = 25% slip to milestone date or 2 failed canary rollouts in a 7-day window
